ideal: If a reading in a unit of a document says a word, and a document that is context for that document holds a unit that declares the word, then the word is not a word that a reading says and nothing declares.
note: one conditional sentence instead of five named variables

ideal: A definition can be said kind by kind exactly when it has no alternative that does not begin with its kind, no run of and beside another alternative of its kind, and no alternative that says something about another unit.
note: "is not a definition with X" said as "has no X"

ideal: When a list has a clause before its last that begins with a time phrase, verbalizer says it as bullets.
If a reading in a unit says a word that is declared, but not by that unit, then the word is a word whose reading is in another unit than its declaration.
note: "declared, but not by that unit" folds two conditions

ideal: A claim is unguarded exactly when it is neither refined nor tested.
When a list of alternatives has an alternative that holds an and, verbalizer says it as bullets that cannot be read two ways.
Checker reports a finding for every hidden bug.
It must be possible for one definition both to have two alternatives for one kind and to have a run of and beside another alternative of its kind.
note: "one definition both ... and ..." instead of a list

ideal: When checker reports the formula of a unit as lone on some word, no other formula can contradict that formula.
note: word quantified with "some word" inside the condition

ideal: Verbalizer says a definition as one sentence when its alternatives are of one kind and it can be said kind by kind.
A unit is tested exactly when a test checks it, or it is a spec and a test checks a bug that sits in it.
note: one sentence instead of a two-item list

ideal: Checker reports a freelancing for every unfounded unit.
A command is available exactly when it is a command that the checker has of its own, or an installed plugin that applies to some document adds it.
note: the existential plugin and document said as "an installed plugin that applies to some document"

ideal: When the statement of a unit is stale, checker writes that statement when it generates.

If a document that is context for another document holds a unit with a block that names a word outside its declaration, checker does not report the formula of any unit of the other document as lone on that word.
note: "any unit of the other document" carries the universal over unit_1

ideal: Verbalizer says a list as bullets when it has more than two clauses and an item that holds a comma.
When checker names a unit in its report of a scenario, leaving out that unit lets the scenario happen.
Checker reports an unpinning for every plain test that checks a bug.
Checker reports a misnesting for every fact that cites a unit.
Checker reports an unpairing for every conflict that is not paired.
It must be possible for a document that keeps readings to hold a unit that holds a formula, whose statement is current, and whose statement checker does not report.
note: the five conditions as relative clauses on one document and one unit

ideal: Checker reports a misindexing for every document that holds a unit but no index.
It must be possible for a list to have more than two clauses but three or fewer, and an item that holds a comma.
note: the two clause counts joined as one range

ideal: A claim is refined exactly when a spec or an exception sits in it.
A test is misleading exactly when it is an expected failure that checks no bug and no exception, or a plain test that checks a bug.
note: one sentence instead of a list

ideal: Checker reports a freelancing for every bug that cites no spec.
When the formula of a unit names a word that has no reading, that formula cannot be said in words.

Checker reports a word when any of these holds:
- a reading says it and nothing declares it
- it is declared in a unit that is not a term
- its reading is in another unit than its declaration
- no claim, definition or fact uses it
note: "word_1 is a word that ..." cut to the clause about it

ideal: A frontmatter lists a plugin exactly when it holds an entry that spells the plugin.
When the project has a runner, checker reports an untesting for every bug that is not tested.
note: the runner condition set apart from the per-bug one

ideal: Checker reports an orphaning for every unit that is not used and is not a conflict.

Checker does not report a word when none of these holds:
- a reading says it and nothing declares it
- it is declared in a unit that is not a term
- its reading is in another unit than its declaration
- no claim, definition or fact uses it
note: "none of these holds" instead of four negations

ideal: Verbalizer says a list as bullets when it is a run of clauses joined by and or by or that cannot be put in a sentence.
note: result first, condition as a relative clause

ideal: When a list has a clause before its last with a relative clause in it, verbalizer says it as bullets.
Checker reports a finding for every hidden bug, every hidden conflict and every misleading test.
note: three quantified statements merged into one list of objects

ideal: When a unit is held with units that cannot all hold, checker names in its report of a contradiction every unit that the analyzer is asked about together with it.
Checker reports a misindexing for every document that holds an index that does not match it.
Checker reports a misanchoring for every unit that a trailer follows.
